main_text.l: Sceptra tenet, justique modos praescribit ubivis
Quod licet hîc, alibi licitum lex lata nega-
Quodque meum est, alibi non sinet
Jus negat, & lites parturit ipse locus.
Quae mala dum passim vixarum pullulat
Magne Vir, has calamo tu, velut ense secas.
Jurâque qui penetras, jam sic nostra
Errorum ut reseces hîc simul omne caput.
Grande tibi statuet plaudens Themis ipsa trophaeum,

page.notes: Verse lines are set with irregular indents; the transcription keeps line content but not the exact indentation. Words with doubtful letters: "vixarum" (possibly "vipera" or "vixarum" as printed), "ense" (final letter possibly a Cyrillic-like look-alike; read as ense). Lines with broken words "nega-/bit", "ca-/put" are joined. Hyphenation at line ends: "nega-bit" printed as "negabit", "ca-put" printed as "caput". Signature line "L. vandé POLL." and "J. CIUS." are printed names; "CIUS" is printed as CIus, read as Cius. Stains and show-through present; a digitiser watermark ("Digitized by Google") omitted.
